I got one bag of NPK and one bag of urea from the FISP coupon this year, so I will spread that on this 1.36-hectare maize plot where I also planted hybrid seed. I added two cartloads of goat manure from the kraal because the land belongs to my household and I want to keep it producing. We do not spray any chemicals — we weed by hand — so between myself and my children we will work about ninety days on this plot. I will hire five days of outside labor when the weeds rush after the first rains, paying from the little money I kept after selling groundnuts last season.
